mentions.name: Summary World
mentions.description: This tool generates clean text summaries of YouTube videos, designed around principles of learning and retention rather than quick TLDRs. It includes a Related Videos feature that extracts a video's key themes and recommends the top 3 related videos to form a small knowledge web, built-in YouTube search where clicking a video generates a summary, and a public library where users can make their summaries public.
mentions.problem: Existing YouTube summarizers deliver quick TLDRs not aligned with learning and retention, and videos pile up in 10+ browser tabs instead of being consumable as text.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I'm building this: https://summaryworld.life

It gives you clean text summaries of YouTube videos. There are obviously other tools that do this, but I wanted something that is aligned with actual principles of learning and retention, not just quick TLDRs.
